content: RFQs must include material type, quantity, delivery location, delivery date, and requester contact before supplier outreach.
External supplier messages require human approval before sending. Drafts may be prepared automatically, but sending is an approved action.
Credit requests must include applicant identity, requested amount, repayment term, supporting documents, and risk notes.
Users may only access documents and actions assigned to their role. Credit data must not be exposed to unauthorized users.
Every external action must record requester, approver, timestamp, input reference, output reference, and action result.
